title: State, local website improvements crucial as more residents use AI assistants to get important info, report says
summary: Residents are relying more on AI-powered summaries for information. Governments can do more to make sure they’re accurate, the report says.

title: Senate panel advances bill to improve disaster search and rescue technology
summary: The legislation would direct a federal research lab to develop technology that helps first responders locate survivors in areas where traditional radio signals cannot reach.

title: Congressional Democrats send letter urging FCC’s Carr to drop E-Rate elimination proposal
summary: The lawmakers argue cutting the federal broadband program would not address concerns about students’ screen time, pointing instead to existing internet-safety requirements and local device-use policies.

title: Pennsylvania pilots sexual assault kit tracking system for survivors ahead of statewide rollout
summary: The pilot aims to help state agencies improve the system, address training and technical needs and ensure the process is consistent, transparent and centered on survivors.

title: After ‘victory lap’ with quick Click-to-Cancel portal launch, NYC’s PIT Crew accelerates towards next projects
summary: Through iterative development, NYC’s in-house digital services team aims to build adaptable technology designed around the people who use it.

title: NYC launches website to connect residents with mental health care
summary: The city’s new online platform helps residents navigate more than 600 mental health and substance use providers with filters for insurance, language and care needs.

title: Georgia launches chatbot to help residents navigate state services
summary: Georgia’s latest digital government initiative aims to reduce call center demand and help residents more easily find official information.

title: Terminating E-Rate would cost US economy over $4B annually, study says
summary: The study found that for every $1 cut from the E-Rate program, the U.S. GDP would be reduced by about $1.60.

title: Minnesota braces for Trump administration cuts to state Medicaid funding due to fraud, demands transparency on federal data analytics tools
summary: The state Medicaid office is asking federal officials to disclose the technology involved in their data analytics to determine whether it should take action against individuals or providers.

title: With potentially historic El Niño looming, California reopens State Operations Center with new disaster intelligence satellite capability
summary: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration has forecasted a 75% chance that this year’s El Niño will become a historic event,  increasing the risk of high tide flooding in parts of the U.S.
